mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment ( post_id, user_id, content, create_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{createTime} )
INSERT INTO post ( content, user_id, images, type, create_time ) VALUES ( #{content}, #{userId}, #{images}, #{type}, #{createTime} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId};
DELETE FROM post WHERE id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId};
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, u.username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, p.content, p.user_id AS userId, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.images, p.type, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id) AS commentCount FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.type = #{type} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT pc.id, u.username, pc.content, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, pc.create_time AS createTime FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN user u ON pc.user_id = u.id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY pc.create_time ASC
